title: The owner's A6 imports of 2026-11-07 pinned, nothing wired: STALHEART-KIDOU (the moving gantry) and the SAI-93 hopper at SentryTowers_A6 87a87206, the crystal lab's kit at lab-crystals 9dfb33c7, the diorama kept as the animation reference, and the YushiRover unchanged upstream
context: Owner's note of 2026-11-07, points 2-4: 'We import the new yushi-rover and stalheart-kidou the moving gantry'; 'this initial animation [stalheart-diorama] is close to what we want'; 'we import this miner [sai93], and these crystals [lab-crystals] for a test'. The owner asleep; the import only (files, pins, facts, checks) for a later design pass, on branch a6-imports-2026-11-07 (worktree ~/Dev/stalheart-a6-imports) off overnight-2026-10-23 2ca0c418, following round 8's convention (docs/a6-settlement-assets.lock.json, assets/models/<name>/, the author's runtime.js adapters kept verbatim, the author's docs in the vault). Both upstreams shallow-cloned into a scratch directory and read as data (no upstream script run); SentryTowers_A6 HEAD 87a87206f38e (2026-11-06 13:51 +0900), lab-crystals HEAD 9dfb33c7fa38 (2026-09-17). Facts measured with the vendored GLTFLoader (r160) on the pinned bytes; the meshopt hazard measured by packing each GLB with scripts/build.mjs's own gltfpack arguments.
outcome: PINNED. docs/a6-kidou-sai93-assets.lock.json (new, the round-8 lock's shape at revision 87a87206, plus `requiredNodes`, `vertexAttributes`, `static` per GLB and a `models` facts block) pins assets/models/stalheart-kidou/{stalheart_kidou_d0_lod1.glb, stalheart_kidou_d0_lod2.glb, runtime.js} and assets/models/sai93/{sai93_unit_d0_lod1.glb, sai93_unit_d0_lod2.glb, runtime.js}; docs/lab-crystals.lock.json (new, same shape at 9dfb33c7, with a `facts` block) pins assets/models/crystals/{geometry.js, shaders.js}. scripts/assets.mjs reads both and gains one generic check: a lock entry's `requiredNodes` must all be named nodes of the GLB (every pivot and socket the two adapters look up; a renamed node upstream now fails assets:check, not a scene). The round-8 lock and every existing model are untouched. LOD0 is left upstream, as round 8 left it. THE KIDOU (author's revision 2): metres, +Y up, +Z forward, root STALHEART_KIDOU_ROOT at the ground, 42.086 x 39.857 x 24.000 m (X/Y/Z, Y 0.0031-39.86), plot 48 x 28 m rotating with the machine; eight steered XB-12 wheels at X +-16, Z +-9/+-3, rolling radius 1.82 m, trailing arms 3 m, travel +-0.55 m; sockets EXTRUSION_TIP (0.0505, 3.2104, 2.6) parked, SOCKET_FABRICATION_ORIGIN (0, 0, 2.6), SOCKET_MATERIAL_INPUT (16, 6.0, -11.85), SOCKET_TOW_FRONT (16, 5.6, 12), SOCKET_TOW_REAR (-16, 5.6, -12), SOCKET_CONTACT_{L1-4,R1-4}, SOCKET_DAMPER_{UPPER,LOWER}_*; engine nodes BODY_HEAVE, CARRIAGE_TRAVEL_X, TOOL_LIFT_Z, J1_BASE_YAW..J6_TOOL_ROLL, SUSP_PIVOT_/UPRIGHT_/WHEEL_STEER_/WHEEL_SPIN_/DAMPER_AIM_/DAMPER_ROD_ per wheel, the procedural FEED_HOSE_1/2; GANTRY_TRAVEL_Y fixed at 3.9 m (the Terraformer's rail clip must not play on it). No baked clips; runtime.js stateAt(time, mode) (park, drive, crab, turn, suspension, fabricate; 16 s cycle) and applyKidou(THREE, scene, state) (never moves the root; terrain by callback; LOD2 returns static). LOD1 15,545 tris / 45 draws / 405,820 B (inside the 25k articulated budget, over the 8k / 10 / 400 KB landmark one), LOD2 2,756 / 1 / 154,136 static; D0 only. THE SAI-93 (revision 1): the SAI-92 without its head (no SENSOR_YAW), 5.66 x 3.575 x 5.7316 m neutral landed (the GLB's rest pose measures 5.7535 long: the anchor spikes before the adapter poses the legs), plot 6 x 6; sockets SOCKET_ORE_OUT (0, 2.04, 1.80; full offload 1.38 m further), SOCKET_GAS_IN (-0.66, 1.57, -1.72), SOCKET_CHARGE (0.66, 1.57, -1.72), SOCKET_CARGO (0, 2.68, 0), SOCKET_MINING_CONTACT, SOCKET_LASER_L/R/C, SOCKET_FOOT_*, SOCKET_EXHAUST_*; engine nodes BODY_HEAVE, LEG_*_{YAW,HIP,KNEE,SHOCK_ROD,FOOT,ANCHORS}, THRUSTER_*_GIMBAL, MINING_LIFT/FOLD, AUGER_L/R_ROLL, INTAKE_SCREW_ROLL, LASER_L/R_AIM, ORE_WINDOW_MASK, ORE_GAUGE_FILL, OFFLOAD_STAGE_1/2. No baked clips; runtime.js applySai93(THREE, scene, {fold, anchor, deploy, fill, offload, ...}) and applyBay. LOD1 18,988 / 41 / 662,832 B, LOD2 2,496 / 1 / 201,200 static (half ore); D0 only. Its service bay is byte-identical to the SAI-92 bay pinned in round 8 (assets/models/sai92/sai92_bay_*), so it is not pinned twice. THE MESHOPT HAZARD: none. All four GLBs carry only POSITION, NORMAL and COLOR_0 (one vertex-colour palette material, no textures, skins or morphs); packed with the build's arguments every name, every node's extras and the roots' userData (lod, static) survive, FEED_HOSE_1/2 still load as meshes, and the adapters pose plain and packed copies to within 3.6e-7 m; so neither model goes on scripts/build.mjs's UNPACKED list, and test/a6-kidou-sai93-crystals.mjs holds the condition (a custom attribute would have to ship unpacked). THE CRYSTALS: no model upstream; the crystals are procedural code (crystalGeometry(shape, sides, aspect, seed) over THREE.ConvexGeometry, unitless ~2.5 tall, at most 40 convex planes in userData.planes; a spectral-glass ray-traced and an energy shader). Written for Three 0.186: geometry.js's bare 'three' imports do not load in the game (no import map), ConvexGeometry is not vendored (ConvexHull is), r160 has no MeshPhysicalMaterial.dispersion; the shaders' chunks exist in r160. Pinned as the kit, not loadable as it is. THE ROVER: upstream's yushi-rover at 87a87206 is byte-identical to the 40c23fa4 pin (both GLBs, runtime.js, manifest, README, mission.js), so nothing changed and nothing was re-pinned. THE DIORAMA (reference only, in the vault): a 144 s deterministic runtime one-shot, ISAO_STALHEART_Settlement_Sequence, ten chapters: ISAO arrives (0-6), prints the gantry as linework left leg (6-13), right leg (15-22), top span (24-26), roof (26-28), the hanging arm (28-30), holds (30-34), the materials appear bottom to top (34-44), the arm prints a full-size MORK in cyan wireframe (50-72), the gantry rolls 52 m along +Z (78-98) and prints a half-scale Dome City habitat in green wireframe (104-132), the camera opens out (132-144); its game-tier sources (the KIDOU LOD1, ISAO LOD1, the MORK low tier, the habitat LOD1) are all now pinned in the game.
alternatives: Add the new files to docs/a6-settlement-assets.lock.json with per-file baseUrl overrides: rejected, that lock's revision and credit describe 40c23fa4 and stay immutable; one revision per lock, as every lock has it
Pin the SAI-93 bay under assets/models/sai93/ as upstream ships it: rejected, byte-identical to the pinned SAI-92 bay (385 KB twice for no difference); the lock credit and the test say so
Pin LOD0 too: rejected, round 8 left LOD0 upstream; the KIDOU's is 7.6 MB, and the design pass can fetch it by hash from the manifest if a close shot needs it

Ship the crystal lab's main.js, or convert a crystal to a GLB: rejected, main.js is a DOM page (kept in the vault as the uniform/cluster reference), and an export would be a model the author did not ship
Put the new GLBs on the build's UNPACKED list to be safe: rejected, measured: the pack loses nothing they carry
